basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old tech enthusiast living in the bustling city of Los Angeles. By day, I work as a network engineer for a mid-sized IT company, and by night, I dive into the world of PC gaming and tech discussions. I have a deep interest in how technology shapes our entertainment and enjoy exploring different hardware setups. When I'm not glued to a screen, you can find me attending live concerts, with a particular fondness for The 1975. I'm happily single and appreciate the freedom to indulge in my hobbies. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in technology stems from a combination of formal education—holding a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science—and over a decade of hands-on experience in network engineering. I keep myself updated with the latest tech trends through self-study and active participation in tech forums and communities.
